messages:
Priya: quick proposal — add circuit-aware retry shaping at the gateway to avoid hammering upstream backends when their CBs open. also add a tiny short-term buffer for streaming to allow fast resume if the circuit briefly recovers. thoughts?
Jamal: +1 to avoiding the hammer. main worry = memory usage for per-tenant buffering. need clear eviction and budgets.
Theo: piggybacking CB state sounds doable. we already emit cb state to the control plane. recommend per-tenant retry budgets + backoff windows with jitter.
Priya: sketch of headers and behavior: 
```
# headers the proxy can set
X-RW-Proxy-Retry-Hint: retryable | no-retry | fallback
X-RW-Proxy-CB-State: closed | half-open | open
X-RW-Proxy-Resume-Token: <opaque-token> (set in trailer when buffer allowed)
```
and pseudo-decision: 
```
if cb_state == open: set Retry-Hint=no-retry; if streaming && buffer_available: attach Resume-Token in trailer and keep N seconds of tail; else return 503/fallback
else normal retry policy
```
Jamal: for streaming resume — how would client consume? propose we return a 202-like acceptance with resume token in trailers, or set a short-lived token header when we close. example: 
```
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
X-RW-Resume-Token: rtk-abc123
Trailer: X-RW-Resume-Token
...stream body...
<end>
```
Client can re-open with If-Resume-Token: rtk-abc123.
Theo: note on billing & SLAs — buffering increases proxy resource time. we should mark buffered segments as 'transient' and avoid double-billing if we replay. also cap buffer TTL (max 3s or configured per-tier).
Ops: important: do not extend request beyond SLA. fallback if buffer can't be held: immediate 5xx or upstream-fallback. add metric proxy.retry_shaping.skipped_retries and proxy.resume_buffer.evictions.
infra-bot: feature-flag created: proxy_circuit_shaping (default: off) and metric hooks registered.
Priya: next steps: I'll draft RFC with flow diagrams and per-tier memory caps. volunteers: @Jamal to implement CB hook + resume token lifecycle, @Theo to add metrics & billing tags, @Ops to draft runbook.
Jamal: I'll take CB hook. plan: simple in-memory LRU per-tenant buffer, cap 1MB per tenant initially, instrument and revisit.
Theo: I'll add Prometheus metrics + alert thresholds for buffer_evictions and skipped_retries. will add billing annotation to request traces.
Ops: I'll prepare canary plan and runbook steps (how to disable feature-flag & rollback). include a playbook entry: if resume_token_count spikes -> disable.
Priya: :thumbsup: thanks all — I'll schedule a 30m sync next tuesday to run the draft RFC and PoC plan.
